Metadata.Title: Sapienza — Operation: Destruction
Metadata.Description: Silvio Caruso, and his assistant, Francesca De Santis. Get them killed. Oh, and take care of at least one of Francesca's bodyguards, and the lead scientists as well. Can't be too careful. Good luck, 47. I will leave you to prepare.Some additional information:— Make sure that if you shoot, don't miss the head.— Do it all in your suit. Don't ask why.— You have 5 minutes, and every second counts. Don't waste time.— You can only leave by seaplane.— Make sure to not get caught on camera.
